name: sokoban
description: 萌寵推龍 · 倉庫番 — Capacitor Android/iOS wrapper around the Sokoban web build

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build:web && cap sync android && node scripts/fix-android-generated.mjs
scripts.cap:sync:ios: npm run build:web && cap sync ios && node scripts/fix-ios-generated.mjs
scripts.android:bundle: npm run cap:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
